remarks: Welcome to 550 Ridgefield road, a charming retreat offering a peaceful and private lifestyle! This delightful 3-bedroom cottage, nestled on a stunning 5-acre estate, is move-in ready. Step inside to find a warm and inviting family room, characterized by its exposed beams and beautiful hardwood floors. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a gas stove and ample pantry space, perfect for culinary enthusiasts and family gatherings. Enjoy entertaining or relaxing with a good book on the lovely porch that overlooks breathtaking views of the meadows. With access to nearby hiking trails, outdoor adventures are right at your doorstep.For your convenience, the owner covers exterior maintenance. Plus, you'll find a washer and dryer located on the main floor for easy laundry access.  Pets are welcome at 550 Ridgefield, making it an ideal home for your furry friends too! Don't miss the opportunity to live in this serene and picturesque environment. Schedule a viewing today!
